recommendation.rationale: Reviewed predicates add coherent first-person content while preserving source grammar. At .75 the measured word gain is modest; at .25 whole-unit priority loses three words and four nonempty messages, mostly pronoun-only exposure but also valid isolated content/repeated nouns. Accept this as a phrase-priority tradeoff, not a coverage increase claim.
limitations: No material error identified in this finite reviewed packet; not proof of universal sense safety.
Social-media liking and human-hair omissions remain deliberate gaps; no whitelist expansion proposed.
I know acknowledgement adds little content depth; acquaintance/object agreement is minor on the authored John control.
Fixed following-context lists and finite left operators do not establish arbitrary clause scope or eliminate all discourse-like/idiom ambiguity.
No automatic mastery, population accuracy or 90% usefulness claim.
